title: SkillLib
description: A mod that allows modpack creators to create their own skills.
body:
For a detailed tutorial on skill registration related to this mod, please visit: https://github.com/Yvliux/SkiLLlib
If you're a modpack creator looking to create an RPG-style project but can't find a skill and progression mod that satisfies you, then give this a try. SkillLib provides you with the framework and UI, allowing you to freely create your own skills and character attribute progression paths. Acquiring skills is as simple as setting up the corresponding rewards in FTB Quests.
